comment: Pinned llama.cpp Windows CPU runtime. The CPU build is deliberate: the Vulkan build is
~55 MB larger and depends on the user's GPU driver, which is a support liability on an alpha.
Do NOT switch this back to /releases/latest. Every real llama.cpp build release is published as
a GitHub prerelease (~48 per day), so /releases/latest resolves to the v0.3.0 marker release,
whose only asset is nightly-tag.txt. Re-pin with tools/fetch-llama-runtime.ps1 -Tag bNNNN
-UpdateLock, which re-reads the release API and rewrites sizeBytes/sha256 from the published digest.
sha256 is the GitHub per-asset digest and is verified twice: once by the fetch script and once by
RuntimeBootstrapService on the rare path where the app has to provision the runtime itself.
